parameters.content:
## Receive

One turn per call: sessionId, transcript, ASR confidence.

## Load state

Prompts (goals, rules, spoken lines), the session row and the market row are the only state the model sees.

## Gates and prompt

YesNoGate: a deterministic yes or no in IDENTIFY, CONSENT and DEALER moves the state before the model runs, so a small model cannot loop on a confirmed question. The system prompt is rebuilt every turn from ar_prompts and the facts.

## Reason

The agent has three tools, Postgres memory and a structured parser with auto-fix.

## Guards 1: gates

The model's output is clamped to the allowed values, then each rule is an If (the condition) and an Edit Fields (what it changes). Gates: a deterministic yes or no in IDENTIFY and CONSENT wins over the model.

## Guards 2: caller and booking

Caller asks for a person: handoff. A booking claim without a confirmation code is replaced by a question. A booking made by a tool forces BOOKED.

## Guards 3: reply and end

Empty or over-long replies are fixed. A handoff always speaks the market's handover line. No end before BOOKED or WRAPUP.

## Handoff

A model failure answers with a fixed apology and PLATFORM_ERROR. Any handoff builds the Refer-To through AR-14.

## Respond

Session update, event row, the reply the gateway speaks.

## AR-02 Dialogue turn

The brain. State lives in ar_sessions; the system prompt is rebuilt every turn. Guards after the model: no booking claim without a confirmation code, no slot that was not offered, no end before WRAPUP.

## Tools

FindDealers, FindSlots, BookAppointment. sessionId is plumbed, never a model parameter. Handoff is not a tool: it is a deterministic consequence of action=handoff.

meta.description: POST /webhook/ar/v1/session/turn. One call per caller utterance. Loads the session, runs the dialogue agent with its three tools, applies deterministic guards, builds the handoff context when needed, updates the session and logs. Returns speak, action, state and handoff.
